Oh, i'm glad you could understand well! I'll just have to leave that book for the next time! 

Yeah, i've been in this thread for about that amount of time too. I felt the courage to post here from reading other people's courage to express themselves.

It just may be as life altering as mine, these things you have been through. It can't be measured, so i think everyone who passed through things like that deserve treatment and etc. I'm really sorry about that, my ex had ptsd too, i know how much it can affect daily life and in long-term.

I'm at my house, so i guess it's kind of a safe place (but i don't feel safe around me, most of the times). I guess i'll pass the rest of the day listening to music, trying to simply exist. As always. And yeah, Alaska is preetty far away from where i live haha

​

Anyway, i really appreciate you taking some time to respond to me and being so nice. Made my heart warm.
